author: Rivzz
body:
Hello guys! My name is 14carfan, and today I have my recent drawing of me! This is my first official drawing, so it isn't the best. However in the future I plan to get better at drawing these and hopefully can get into art school! The skin that I modeled off was origionally created by Meggles, You can find her here - http://www.planetminecraft.com/member/meggles/ 

The skin that Meggles made isn't the exact skin I drew, however I used it for a model. Thanks so much guys, I'll be back soon with more drawings! Hopefully this isn't too bad! Bye Bye for now!

replies.body: Hi. I was wondering how were you able to upload the picture?

replies.author: Rivzz
replies.body: All you have to do is click the "Insert Image" tab, when creating a thread. Then, you need to make sure there is an online image for the picture. Then just copy its url and paste it into the "Insert Image" tab. That is it.
